fields.description: Off by default. The gate fails closed: with this off, every extraction waits for a person.
fields.label: Auto Accept Above Threshold

fields.description: Only meaningful when Auto Accept is on. A policy that auto-accepts with no threshold would accept everything.
fields.label: Confidence Threshold

fields.description: One fieldname per line. These are never auto-accepted, whatever the confidence.
fields.label: Never Auto Accept

fields.description: One line per DocType: Sales Invoice: grand_total, customer, due_date
fields.label: Fields By DocType

fields.description: How long a draft is kept before it is pruned. Drafts are an audit trail, not a business record.
fields.label: Retention Days

fields.description: Document text is sent to a provider. This must be set before any extraction runs — the operator says it out loud rather than inheriting a default.
fields.label: Data Leaves Site

fields.description: The most bytes one extraction will read. 8 MiB.
fields.label: Max File Bytes
